title: MCP instructions: when the data cannot answer a question, say what is missing and offer the computation; never fill the gap with an assumed value
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ① shipped AI guidance gap, measured. `reach:` the fifth gallery debut refresh, 2026-11-15T12:4xZ (card `asset_lifecycle`, published 18.4.0, runner at objectstack main `b0056382`, model claude-opus-5-5). Every other check passed: Build 144/144, 问数 14/15, operations 6/6, Iterate 155/155 · 15/15 · 6/6. The gallery export was refused on this one answer. Epic objectstack-ai/cloud#3600; gallery #30349.

## What happened

Question `laptop_warranty_expiring`, "Which laptops' warranties run out before the end of this year?", has truth `unanswerable`: no object records a warranty. The agent, an MCP client reading this server's instructions, correctly said it cannot answer from the data. It then added:

> "**An assumption, not data:** if laptops come with a typical warranty of 1 year or longer, none would run out before 2026-12-31…"

It also volunteered derived counts ("30 laptops … 23 in use, 6 in stock and 1 in repair"). The grader failed the turn with "stated a figure the data cannot support". **The grade is right:** an assumed warranty term and a conclusion drawn from it ("none") are an answer the data cannot support. That is the risk a customer's MCP client carries the same way. Runs 1–3 that day declined cleanly, so the behaviour varies.

## Carrier

The MCP door's instructions (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`, the client-facing SKILL.md) tell the client how to choose between a governed metric and an object query, and to say so when measures are withheld. They say nothing about a question the data **cannot** answer.

## Ask

1. Add one rule to the MCP instructions for that case:
   - say the data does not record it, and name what is missing (here, a warranty end date);
   - offer the computation if the user supplies the missing parameter;
   - **never** fill the gap with an assumed value or a conclusion drawn from one;
   - figures you volunteer must come from a tool answer, as a cited source.
2. Keep it to one bullet beside the dataset rule, in the house register. If an eval set exists for the MCP door, add this case to it.
3. Proof: the rendered instructions carry the rule (the renderer's test). A live re-run is the daily gallery task's job.

Reader: the `domain:skills` lane seat, which owns the client-facing instruction text; if `packages/mcp` is another lane's surface, triage reroutes. Dedupe: `skill-md cannot answer assumption`, no hit. Priority p3: guidance coverage.
